# Muhammad Asad Iqbal

> Full-Stack Developer based in Islamabad, Pakistan, specializing in
> React Native mobile apps, Next.js web development, and WordPress sites
> built with Bricks Builder and Elementor. Available worldwide.

## About

Asad started his career as an SEO Graduate Trainee at Allure, transitioned to
Trainee Software Developer, and currently works as an Associate Software
Engineer. His SEO background informs every web project — sites are built to
rank as well as look good. He has shipped two mobile apps to both the Apple
App Store and the Google Play Store.

## Services

- React Native + Expo mobile app development (iOS + Android)
- App Store and Play Store submission and maintenance
- Next.js / React / Node full-stack web development
- WordPress development with Bricks Builder and Elementor
- Technical SEO for React/Next.js sites (Core Web Vitals, schema, semantic HTML)

## Notable Projects

- BrothersFix — On-demand appliance repair mobile app, live on the App Store
  and Play Store. Built with React Native, Expo, EAS Build, Firebase, OneSignal.
- Quickworx — Two-sided services marketplace mobile app, live on the App Store
  and Play Store. Built with React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Firebase, Stripe.
- High-Performance Bricks Build — Custom WordPress site with Core Web Vitals in
  the green (LCP < 1.5s, CLS < 0.05) and Lighthouse 95+.
